customer_id.meaning: Primary id of the customer (named insured) profile (content hash).

name.meaning: Full legal name of the named insured exactly as on the driver's license.

phone_number.meaning: Primary phone number on file; a verification credential.

email.meaning: Email address on file, lower case; a verification credential.

date_of_birth.meaning: Date of birth of the named insured; a verification credential.

drivers_license_last4.format: last 4 characters of the driver's license number, as printed
drivers_license_last4.meaning: Last four characters of the named insured's driver's license number; a verification credential.

mailing_street.meaning: Street line of the mailing address.

mailing_state.meaning: State of the mailing address (two-letter code).

mailing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the mailing address; a verification credential.

customer_since.meaning: Date the customer profile was opened (first Cardinal policy bound).

prior_insurance_months.meaning: Months of continuous auto insurance with another carrier immediately before the first Cardinal policy, as verified at new business.

homeowner.meaning: Whether the named insured owns their residence (drives the homeowner discount).

multi_policy.meaning: Whether the customer holds an in-force Cardinal homeowners, condominium or renters policy (drives the multi-policy discount).

paperless_enrolled.meaning: Whether the customer receives policy and billing documents electronically (drives the paperless discount).

vehicle_id.meaning: Primary id of a household vehicle record.

customer_id.meaning: Household (customer) that owns or leases the vehicle (foreign key -> customers).

make.meaning: Manufacturer as printed on the title.

model.meaning: Model as printed on the title.

ownership_type.meaning: Whether the vehicle is owned outright, financed under a lien, or leased.

lienholder_name.meaning: Lienholder or lessor exactly as printed on the finance or lease contract; empty when owned outright.

acquisition_date.meaning: Date the household took delivery of the vehicle (bill of sale or lease start).

purchased_new.meaning: Whether the household bought or leased the vehicle new as its first retail owner.

garaging_zip.meaning: ZIP code where the vehicle is principally garaged, as last reported.

garaging_state.meaning: State where the vehicle is principally garaged.

driver_id.meaning: Primary id of a household driver record.

customer_id.meaning: Household (customer) the driver belongs to (foreign key -> customers).

full_name.meaning: Driver's full name exactly as on the license.

date_of_birth.meaning: Driver's date of birth; ages are computed on a rating date in whole years.

relationship.meaning: Relationship of the driver to the named insured.

license_state.meaning: State that issued the driver's license.

license_number.meaning: Driver's license number exactly as printed.

license_status.meaning: Current license status from the latest motor vehicle report.

first_licensed_date.meaning: Date the driver was first issued a full driver's license (any state).

household_join_date.meaning: Date the member became a licensed household driver: the later of the move-in date and the license issue date.

good_student_verified.meaning: Whether a full-time student transcript at or above the good student GPA is on file for the current school term.

defensive_course_date.meaning: Completion date of the most recent approved defensive driving course; empty if none.

record_id.meaning: Primary id of one motor vehicle report or loss history incident.

driver_id.meaning: Driver the incident is charged to (foreign key -> drivers).

record_type.meaning: Class of incident used for surcharges and eligibility.

incident_date.meaning: Date of the violation or accident; lookback windows are counted on this date.

paid_amount.meaning: Total paid by any insurer on the accident (0.00 for violations).

worksheet_id.meaning: Primary id of one vehicle rating worksheet produced by the rating engine.

policy_id.meaning: Policy the worksheet was produced for (foreign key -> auto_policies).

rated_variant_name.meaning: Coverage package the base premiums were rated for.

term_effective_date.meaning: First day of the term the worksheet applies to.

liability_base_premium.meaning: Full-term base premium for the package's liability, medical payments and uninsured motorist coverages on this vehicle, before surcharges and discounts.

physdmg_base_premium.meaning: Full-term base premium for collision and comprehensive on this vehicle at the reference deductible, before the deductible factor, surcharges and discounts.

worksheet_date.meaning: Date the rating engine produced the worksheet.

order_id.meaning: Primary id of a state financial-responsibility order on file.

driver_id.meaning: Driver the order names (foreign key -> drivers).

issuing_state.meaning: State motor vehicle agency that issued the order.

order_basis.meaning: Offense or event that triggered the order.

case_number.meaning: State case or order number exactly as printed on the order letter.

required_through_date.meaning: Last day the state requires continuous proof of financial responsibility.

policy_id.meaning: Primary id of the auto policy (content hash).

variant_name.meaning: Coverage package currently on the policy, as its official name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle status of the policy (see the auto charter lifecycle).

policy_state.meaning: Garaging state whose law governs the policy.

term_effective_date.meaning: First day of the current term (coverage starts 12:01 a.m.).

term_expiration_date.meaning: Expiration date of the current term (coverage ends 12:01 a.m.).

inception_date.meaning: Original inception date of the policy with Cardinal.

cancellation_effective_date.meaning: Cancellation effective date printed on a pending or completed cancellation notice; kept after reinstatement as the start of the lapse; empty if none.

end_date.meaning: Date coverage ended (cancellation, nonrenewal or expiration); empty while bound or in force.

end_reason.meaning: Ground of the pending or completed termination; none while no termination is pending.

financial_responsibility_filing.meaning: Whether at least one SR-22 or FR-44 filing on this policy is requested, filed, accepted or cancel_notified.

transaction_id.meaning: Primary id of the policy transaction (endorsement, premium or notice).

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the auto charter.

effective_date.meaning: Date the change or premium takes effect.

vehicle_id.meaning: Vehicle added, kept, removed, re-garaged or whose optional coverage changed (foreign key -> vehicles); empty when not vehicle-specific.

replaced_vehicle_id.meaning: Vehicle leaving the policy in a replacement; empty otherwise.

driver_id.meaning: Driver added, excluded or removed (foreign key -> drivers); empty otherwise.

request_id.meaning: Signed request carried out by this transaction (foreign key -> auto_change_requests); empty otherwise.

source_transaction_id.meaning: For an additional or return premium row, the transaction that produced it; for an optional-coverage change, the physical damage, rental reimbursement or roadside assistance coverage record that changed; empty otherwise.

term_effective_date.meaning: First day of the term a term premium, renewal offer or nonrenewal notice belongs to.

full_term_premium_before.meaning: Full-term premium rated before the change.

full_term_premium_after.meaning: Full-term premium rated with the change (for a renewal offer, the renewal premium offered).

premium_amount.meaning: Premium written by a term-premium, additional-premium or return-premium row; always positive, direction given by the event family.

premium_effect.meaning: Whether the endorsement produces additional premium, return premium or no premium change.

garaging_zip.meaning: New garaging ZIP code on a garaging change; empty otherwise.

lienholder_name.meaning: Loss payee exactly as printed on the finance or lease contract on a lienholder change; empty when a lien is released.

offered_variant_name.meaning: Package named on a renewal offer, or the new package of a package endorsement.

notice_date.meaning: Date a renewal offer was issued or a nonrenewal notice was mailed.

recorded_date.meaning: Date the transaction was processed (ctx.now() date).

request_id.meaning: Primary id of a policy change request that needs the named insured's signature.

policy_id.meaning: Policy the request concerns (foreign key -> auto_policies).

driver_id.meaning: Driver to be excluded on a named driver exclusion; empty on a cancellation request.

requested_effective_date.meaning: Effective date the named insured asks for on the request.

signed_date.meaning: Date the named insured signed; empty while awaiting signature.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

billing_account_id.meaning: Primary id of the billing account.

policy_id.meaning: Auto policy billed through this account (foreign key -> auto_policies).

variant_name.meaning: Pay plan on the account, as its official name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle status of the billing account (see the billing charter lifecycle).

closed_date.meaning: Date the account closed; empty while open.

term_effective_date.meaning: First day of the policy term currently being billed.

autopay_enrolled.meaning: Whether installments are drafted automatically from the method on file.

installment_due_day.meaning: Day of the month installments fall due.

account_balance.meaning: Billed-and-unpaid balance; positive means the customer owes, negative is a credit; always equals the sum of the account_balance ledger deltas.

certified_funds_until.meaning: Last day only certified funds are accepted after repeated returned payments; empty when no restriction.

entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the ledger entry.

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the billing charter.

source_transaction_id.meaning: Auto premium transaction, endorsement, SR-22 transmission or telematics device event the entry is tied to; empty otherwise.

premium_change_type.meaning: On a premium change, whether it is a term premium, additional premium or return premium; empty otherwise.

amount.meaning: Amount of the entry, always positive; whether it raises or lowers the balance is given by the event family.

term_effective_date.meaning: First day of the policy term the entry belongs to.

installment_number.meaning: Installment of the term (1 = down payment); empty when not installment-specific.

invoice_date.meaning: Date an installment invoice was issued.

due_date.meaning: Due date of an installment or immediate charge.

fee_type.meaning: Which fee a fee or waiver entry concerns.

original_entry_id.meaning: The ledger entry this entry reverses, waives or charges against (returned payment, waived fee, phone payment); empty otherwise.

payment_method.meaning: Method of a payment or refund.

payment_channel.meaning: Channel through which a payment was made.

return_reason.meaning: Bank or issuer reason for a returned payment.

writeoff_reason.meaning: Why a balance was written off.

notice_mail_date.meaning: Date a notice of cancellation was mailed.

cancellation_effective_date.meaning: Cancellation effective date printed on a notice of cancellation.

minimum_due_to_rescind.meaning: Amount required to rescind a notice of cancellation.

posted_date.meaning: Date the entry posted to the account.

request_id.meaning: Primary id of a reinstatement request awaiting the named insured's signed no-loss statement.

billing_account_id.meaning: Billing account to reinstate (foreign key -> billing_accounts).

lapse_start_date.meaning: Cancellation effective date, the first day without coverage.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

coverage_id.meaning: Primary id of the physical damage coverage on one vehicle.

policy_id.meaning: Auto policy the vehicle is scheduled on (foreign key -> auto_policies).

variant_name.meaning: Deductible option, as its official name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle status of the coverage (see the physdmg charter lifecycle).

effective_date.meaning: Date physical damage took effect on the vehicle.

end_date.meaning: Date physical damage ended; empty while not removed.

inspection_due_date.meaning: Last day for the photo inspection; empty when exempt.

inspection_completed_date.meaning: Date the inspection was accepted (the effective date when exempt); empty until then.

storage_start_date.meaning: First day of the current storage period; empty when not in storage.

deductible_change_effective_date.meaning: Effective date of the latest deductible option change; empty if never changed.

loan_lease_payoff.meaning: Whether the loan/lease payoff option is carried.

deductible_credit_balance.meaning: Deductible Rewards credit available; always equals the sum of the deductible_credit deltas.

loss_payee_name.meaning: Lienholder or lessor exactly as on the finance or lease contract; empty when owned outright.

claim_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the claim event.

coverage_id.meaning: Physical damage coverage of the damaged vehicle (foreign key -> physdmg_coverages).

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the physdmg charter.

claim_number.meaning: Claim number of the damaged vehicle's claim, e.g. PD-2026-0418873.

occurrence_reference.meaning: Reference shared by all claims arising from one occurrence.

report_date.meaning: Date the loss was first reported to Cardinal.

driver_id.meaning: Driver at the time of loss (foreign key -> drivers); empty for a parked or stolen vehicle.

drivable.meaning: Whether the vehicle can be driven safely after the loss.

coverage_part.meaning: Coverage part the claim is decided under.

denial_reason.meaning: Ground of a denial; none when accepted.

deductible_amount.meaning: Deductible that applies to the claim after waivers and the occurrence rule, before Deductible Rewards credit.

insured_fault_pct.meaning: Percent of fault charged to the Cardinal driver.

other_party_insured.meaning: Insurance status of the other party.

estimate_amount.meaning: Gross amount of the estimate version (a supplement's own amount only); on a total-loss declaration, the repair estimate total.

repair_shop_type.meaning: Whether the repair is at a Cardinal Select Shop.

glass_work.meaning: Whether the estimate is glass work, and which kind.

acv_amount.meaning: Actual cash value from the valuation report.

salvage_value.meaning: Highest salvage bid for the vehicle.

prior_damage_amount.meaning: Unrepaired prior damage noted in the valuation.

replacement_cost_new.meaning: Price of a new vehicle of the same make, model and trim, current model year.

custom_equipment_value.meaning: Documented value of aftermarket custom parts and equipment not in actual cash value.

notice_date.meaning: Date a storage notice was sent.

payment_id.meaning: Primary id of the payment, void, recovery or credit entry.

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the physdmg charter.

claim_number.meaning: Claim the entry belongs to; empty for a Deductible Rewards credit grant.

payment_component.meaning: Component of the loss a payment pays.

payee_type.meaning: Who a payment is made to.

payee_name.meaning: Payee exactly as printed on the payment; joint payees joined by ' and '.

estimate_sequence.meaning: Estimate version a repair or supplement payment pays; empty otherwise.

amount.meaning: Amount of the entry, always positive; direction given by the event family.

deductible_applied.meaning: Deductible taken from this payment (after Deductible Rewards credit).

source_payment_id.meaning: Payment voided by a void entry; empty otherwise.

source_recovery_id.meaning: Recovery a deductible reimbursement is paid from; empty otherwise.

recovery_reference.meaning: Remittance or auction settlement number exactly as on the remittance.

credit_reason.meaning: Why Deductible Rewards credit was granted.

credit_period_end.meaning: Last day of the claim-free period a credit was earned for (enrollment date for the enrollment credit).

payment_date.meaning: Date the entry was issued, voided, received or granted.

settlement_id.meaning: Primary id of a total-loss settlement offer awaiting the customer's acceptance.

settlement_option.meaning: Whether the vehicle goes to Cardinal or the customer keeps it.

settlement_amount.meaning: Net settlement offered after deductible (and salvage value when retained).

loss_payee_payoff_amount.meaning: Payoff stated on the loss payee's payoff letter; 0.00 when none.

accepted_date.meaning: Date the customer accepted; empty until accepted.

title_received.meaning: Whether the signed title or owner-retained paperwork has been received.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

rental_coverage_id.meaning: Primary id of the rental reimbursement option on one vehicle.

policy_id.meaning: Auto policy the vehicle is scheduled on (foreign key -> auto_policies).

coverage_id.meaning: Physical damage coverage of the same vehicle (foreign key -> physdmg_coverages).

variant_name.meaning: Rental reimbursement option, as its official name (daily limit / per-loss maximum).

status.meaning: Lifecycle status of the option (see the rental charter lifecycle).

option_change_effective_date.meaning: Effective date of the latest option change; empty if never changed.

end_date.meaning: Date the option ended; empty while not removed.

rental_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the rental ledger entry.

rental_coverage_id.meaning: Option the entry falls under (foreign key -> rental_coverages).

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the rental charter.

claim_number.meaning: Physical damage claim of the vehicle (same claim number as in physdmg_claim_events).

start_date.meaning: First rental day of an authorization.

end_date.meaning: Last covered rental day of a closed authorization.

authorized_days.meaning: Days authorized by an authorization or added by an extension.

extension_sequence.meaning: 1 for the first extension of an authorization, then 2, 3, ...

other_carrier_claim_number.meaning: The at-fault party's insurer's claim number exactly as given by that insurer.

transfer_date.meaning: Day the other insurer's coverage of the rental begins.

invoice_number.meaning: Agency invoice number exactly as printed.

receipt_reference.meaning: Receipt or invoice number of a reimbursement submission exactly as printed.

days_billed.meaning: Rental days on an invoice or reimbursement submission.

daily_rate.meaning: Agency daily rate, taxes and fees included.

amount.meaning: Amount paid or recovered, always positive; direction given by the event family.

customer_responsibility_amount.meaning: Part of the invoice or submitted costs left for the customer.

source_entry_id.meaning: Payment entry a recovery is taken against; empty otherwise.

filing_id.meaning: Primary id of the financial-responsibility filing.

driver_id.meaning: Driver the filing certifies (foreign key -> drivers).

order_id.meaning: State order the filing answers (foreign key -> state_orders).

variant_name.meaning: Certificate type, as its official name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle status of the filing (see the sr22 charter lifecycle).

filing_state.meaning: Ordering state that receives the filing.

certificate_effective_date.meaning: Effective date printed on the certificate.

accepted_date.meaning: Date the state acknowledged the certificate; empty until then.

sr26_effective_date.meaning: Date a transmitted SR-26 takes effect; empty when none is pending.

end_date.meaning: Date the filing lapsed, was released or was closed; empty while open.

sr22_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the filing ledger entry.

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the sr22 charter.

fee_reason.meaning: Why a filing fee is assessed.

transmitted_date.meaning: Business day the transmission was sent.

response_code.meaning: State response to a transmission: accepted, or the rejection code.

source_transaction_id.meaning: Auto endorsement that made an amendment necessary; empty otherwise.

enrollment_id.meaning: Primary id of the DriveSense enrollment.

policy_id.meaning: Auto policy the vehicle is scheduled on (foreign key -> auto_policies).

driver_id.meaning: Driver scored on mobile and teen programs (foreign key -> drivers); empty for vehicle-level programs.

variant_name.meaning: DriveSense program, as its official name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle status of the enrollment (see the telematics charter lifecycle).

observation_start_date.meaning: Date of the first trip; empty until activated.

final_score.meaning: Score fixed at the end of observation; empty until scored.

earned_adjustment_pct.meaning: Earned discount (positive) or surcharge (negative) fixed at scoring; empty until scored.
earned_adjustment_pct.format: signed integer percent, empty until scored

device_serial.meaning: Serial number of the plug-in device assigned; empty when no device.

end_date.meaning: Date the enrollment ended; empty while open.

end_reason.meaning: Why the enrollment ended; none while open.

telematics_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the DriveSense event.

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the telematics charter.

device_serial.meaning: Serial number of the device concerned.

period_start.meaning: First day of the month scored or billed.

period_end.meaning: Last day of the month scored or billed.

active_days.meaning: Days with at least one trip so far in the observation period.

trips.meaning: Trips so far in the observation period.

miles.meaning: Miles driven (score posting), chargeable miles (mileage charge) or miles removed (adjustment).

return_due_date.meaning: Last day a device return is accepted without a fee.

source_event_id.meaning: Mileage charge an adjustment corrects; empty otherwise.

adjustment_reason.meaning: Why a mileage charge was adjusted.

amount.meaning: Fee, mileage charge or credit, always positive; direction given by the event family.

roadside_id.meaning: Primary id of the roadside assistance option on one vehicle.

policy_id.meaning: Auto policy the vehicle is scheduled on (foreign key -> auto_policies).

variant_name.meaning: Roadside option, as its official name.
values: Cardinal Roadside Plus with Trip Interruption

status.meaning: Lifecycle status of the option (see the roadside charter lifecycle).

option_change_effective_date.meaning: Effective date of the latest option change; empty if never changed.

allowance_period_start.meaning: First day of the current allowance period.

service_calls_remaining.meaning: Covered calls left in the current allowance period; always equals the sum of the service_calls deltas of the period.

end_date.meaning: Date the option ended; empty while active.

roadside_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the roadside event.

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the roadside charter.

allowance_period_start.meaning: First day of the allowance period a grant belongs to.

dispatch_number.meaning: Dispatch number of a service call.

tow_miles.meaning: Miles towed (0 when not a tow).

calls.meaning: Service calls granted, used or restored (always positive; direction given by the event family).

covered_amount.meaning: Provider charge paid by Cardinal for a dispatch.

member_charge_reason.meaning: Why the member pays part of a service.

member_paid_amount.meaning: Amount the member pays the provider directly.

source_event_id.meaning: Dispatch whose call is restored; empty otherwise.

receipt_reference.meaning: Provider or expense receipt number exactly as printed.

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the identity verification record (one per customer).

verified.meaning: Whether verification passed; never goes from true back to false.

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the latest verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of the handoff record.

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; exactly these two values.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
